title: Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement
desc:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail.

 - Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation.

 - Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions.

 - Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations.

 - Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans.

 - Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort.

 - Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products.

 - Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data.

 - Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled.

 - Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution.

 - Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners.

 - Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work.

 



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Applied AI Engineer, People
desc: Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. Our goal is to build one of the first AI-native People Operations systems inside a scaling technology company. Instead of a large administrative HR organization, we’re building a small, high-leverage People team powered by smart systems, operational excellence, and AI-enabled processes we invent as we go. Our People team knows our Atomizers (that’s what we call our people) but lacks the technical skills to build systems that scale our people practices. You’ll be the person who turns our ideas into working tools, uncovers redundancy, gets more out of the platforms we already use, and builds AI proficiency across the team. Help us keep up with a high volume of open roles without losing quality or candidate experience. Teach AI fluency. Run hands-on sessions, write simple playbooks and build templates so non-technical teammates can use Claude, ChatGPT and agents confidently. Keep exploring. Stay on top of new AI tools and practices, test them, and bring forward what's actually useful. Handle data responsibly. Treat employee and candidate data with the care and confidentiality it needs. Strong proficiency with Claude Code, plus comfort with Python, SQL and APIs. Experience building dashboards or reporting from messy data. A track record of building efficient, repeatable practices that scale, not one-off scripts. The ability to explain technical ideas in plain language to non-engineers, and patience teaching them. Curiosity about how teams work, and a habit of asking "why do we do it this way?" Good judgment about privacy and handling sensitive information. Nice to Have: Familiarity with both Claude and ChatGPT ecosystems, including MCP connectors, custom GPTs or Projects. Experience with workflow tools or BI platforms. Interest in people operations, talent, or organizational design. Why Join: You'll build agents that reach every team in the company, with real ownership from day one. Your work will shape how a fast-growing deep-tech company hires and supports its people. You'll have the space to experiment with the newest AI tools and see your impact right away. The compensation for this position also includes equity and benefits. Salary Range $110,000 — $150,000 USD Atomic Machines

desc: We’re here for one reason and one reason only – to cure cancer. Every moment is dedicated to developing treatments and every action moves us one step closer to our goal. We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet. Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next. We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows. Job Description We are seeking a highly motivated Research Associate to join our In Vivo Discovery team focused on developing targeted vectors to reprogram cells in vivo for the treatment of cancer. The Research Associate, Research Discovery role is an entry-level scientific professional who performs hands-on laboratory experiments as part of a research team. Working under close supervision from experienced scientists, this individual executes routine experimental procedures and simple to moderately complex assays, following established protocols and good laboratory practices to ensure reliable results. This individual may also support the execution of small animal model studies to evaluate experimental constructs and connect mechanistic findings to in vivo outcomes. The Research Associate systematically collects and analyzes data with guidance, maintains clear and thorough documentation of experiments, and communicates findings to support ongoing projects. This role emphasizes building core laboratory skills and scientific understanding, adaptability in learning new techniques, and collaboration within a team-oriented research environment. Key Responsibilities Plan and perform assigned laboratory experiments of simple to moderate complexity under close supervision, following established protocols and procedures to obtain reliable results. Support hands-on in vivo mouse studies including routine animal handling, dosing/injections (e.g., intravenous tail vein and intraperitoneal, as applicable), IVIS imaging support, blood collection, tissue harvest/dissection, and sample processing in accordance with approved protocols and SOPs. Execute routine experimental tasks accurately and consistently after proper training, adhering to good laboratory practices and all safety guidelines. Identify and troubleshoot basic technical issues during experiments, implementing minor adjustments independently and seeking guidance from experienced scientists for more complex problems. Collect, organize, and analyze experimental data to recognize trends or outcomes, contributing to data interpretation with input from experienced team members. Maintain detailed and organized laboratory records (electronic laboratory notebooks, data logs) to document procedures, observations, and results clearly and thoroughly. Assist in preparing technical summaries or presentations to communicate findings to the team and supervisors. Work collaboratively with research team members and communicate progress regularly to supervisors and project leads, ensuring alignment with project goals and incorporating feedback into ongoing work. Adhere to all laboratory safety protocols and quality standards, helping to maintain a clean, safe, and compliant lab environment. Demonstrate adaptability by learning new experimental techniques or operating new instrumentation with guidance and continuously improve skills through feedback and practice. Contribute to a positive, team-oriented lab culture by being reliable and proactive, offering assistance to colleagues and helping to train new team members on basic laboratory procedures when needed. Maintain mammalian cell lines and primary human cells using sterile technique in a biosafety cabinet. Occasional weekend work might be required. Basic Requirements High School Degree and 3 years of relevant experience OR Associates and 2 years of relevant experience OR Bachelor’s Preferred Qualifications Solid foundation in biological sciences and basic laboratory techniques, with the ability to perform routine experimental procedures and follow protocols with strong attention to detail and accuracy. Familiarity with basic data analysis methods; able to process experimental data and use common software tools (e.g., spreadsheets, graphing programs) to summarize and visualize results. Excellent documentation and record-keeping skills to maintain clear and thorough electronic lab notebooks and records of experiments, observations, and outcomes. Good communication skills (written and verbal) to effectively report experimental results and observations to team members and supervisors. Knowledge of and commitment to laboratory safety procedures and good laboratory practices, ensuring quality and compliance in all experimental activities. Strong organizational and time management abilities to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and meet project deadlines. Collaborative working style and a positive team-oriented attitude, with a willingness to work closely with colleagues, share knowledge, and contribute to team goals. Eagerness to learn and adapt quickly to new techniques or equipment, with an openness to feedback and a commitment to continuous improvement. Bachelor’s degree in biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related life science field 0–2 years of hands-on laboratory research experience in an academic or industry setting (this may include internships or co-op experience). Experience with mammalian cell culture and primary cells is suggested. Prior experience with lentiviral vector production and flow cytometry is preferred. Prior experience mouse handling and interventions including intravenous (tail vein) and intraperitoneal injections are preferred. Experience in a collaborative research environment (academic lab, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical setting) is a plus, demonstrating ability to work effectively in team-driven projects. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to high quality data generation. Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Prism, and other programs to create and distribute reports and key information. Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills. Ability to work onsite in a laboratory environment. The salary range for this position is: $74,715.00 - $96,690.00. title: Consultant Performance Analytics – General Liability
desc: Consultant Perf Analytics - GB08BE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. The General Liability Performance Analytics group is seeking a Performance Analytics Consultant to support operational analytics initiatives. As a member of this team, this person is responsible for creating and owning analytics that measure and monitor performance of key processes, continuous improvement initiatives, and changes in trends in Claims. The individual will perform diagnostic analytics to identify underlying causes for performance and trend change. The individual will partner with teammates in Claims Strategy and Optimization, Claims Performance Analytics, Claims Data Office, Claims Field operations, Actuarial, Underwriting and key stakeholders to identify and prioritize opportunities to optimize business processes and associated practices. Strong communication and relationship building skills are essential as this involves interaction with a wide variety of Claims personnel at all levels, including but not limited to Claims senior leadership, field operations, data science staff, and business segment leaders. WORK ARRANGEMENTS: This role can have a Hybrid or Remote work schedule. Candidates who live near one of our office locations (Hartford, CT, San Antonio, TX, Lake Mary, FL, Phoenix, AZ, Naperville, IL, Alpharetta, GA) will have the expectation of working in an office 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday). Candidates who do not live near an office will have a remote work arrangement, with the expectation of coming into an office as business needs arise. RESPONSIBILTIIES : - Understands end to end performance of critical processes and sub-processes. - Identifies variability in performance metrics and actively participates in the cross-functional team to understand root cause. - Evaluates the measurable impact of process changes/improvement and provide recommendation to Field leadership on relative priority (for either process change or improved execution) - Participates in cross functional design teams on prioritized opportunities. - Understands / monitors data trends and process metrics; present trends and action items to LOB SLT and business segment partners. - Monitors impact of deployed process changes to validate solution effectiveness. - Understanding the end-to-end ramifications of their changes to other processes and results - Supports cross pollination of Claims process to the enterprise. QUALIFICATIONS: - Bachelor’s degree and/or significant line of business experience - Experience in claims or insurance preferred. - Demonstrated strong problem solving, communication, customer focus and change management skills. - Demonstrated ability to build strong partnerships (essential to success for this role) - Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and draw appropriate conclusions. - Experience visualizing data for storytelling a plus. - Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently, and to set priorities and plans to meet business goals and objectives. - Ability to lead without having formal authority and to work both independently and in a team environment. - Flexibility and willingness to adapt to changing trends (operational, industry, and technological) - Strong attention to customer needs and capability to translate into actionable solutions. - Documented track record of creating innovative data solutions; passion for delivering outcomes. - Strong business intelligence and data collection/visualization tool knowledge, such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau, SQL etc. Compensation The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is: $78,800 - $118,200
